notes.title: Musical Update!
notes.content:
Many many many bug fixes and overall stabilization of the game!

FInal sound track is finally here!!

notes.title: A Hugely Graphical Update
notes.content:
After a few months of intense work, here is finally the biggest update to Crazy Wheels so far, which also brings us closer to the game we had envisioned.

Here are a few the many things to discover in this release:
- A complete overhaul of the graphics.
- A new game mode: Ball master with 5 new powerups to control the sphere 
- New maps, new cars, new championships
- And much, much more

notes.title: Early Access Update 5
notes.content:
- Collectibles (Coins) and new cars skins to unlock
- 3 new championships
- New achievements support
- New game mode with 4 new powerups (allowing you to control the ball)

notes.title: Early Access Update 4
notes.content:
- Added 3 championships
- Cars now have different characteristics
- Reworked some of the UI
- Bug fixes and stabilization

notes.title: Early Access Update 3
notes.content:
- Added option to play the maps in reverse (those whose design supports it)
- Modulate the overall car speed for easier learning curve
- Overhauled the physics (car physics have been reviewed and a bounciness added to them. Getting stuck in some elements of the environment should be gone!)
- Improved the level editor (added the option to toggle physics support for the selected object by pressing P, tag your map as reversible)
- 1 new map
- Added resolution setting menu (more graphics options to come later)
- Bug fixes and stabilization

notes.title: Notes for Update 2 (April 5th 2021)
notes.content:
- First pass support for SteamWorkshop (Upload, download, update maps.)
- Improved the level editor
- New power: rocket
- Improved the AI (it is not harder and handles the map better)
- 2 new maps
- All official map are now playable in the online mode

Known issues
- SteamWorkshop integration still lacks informational messages (mostly "a progress bar")
- For now levels created with the level editor don't have all the physics goodness enabled.
